3-5.title: Math Words with Two Meanings
3-5.titleEs: Palabras de matemáticas con dos significados

everyday.def: a piece of furniture with a flat top
everyday.ex: We eat dinner at the kitchen table.

school.def: rows and columns that show numbers or facts
school.ex: The table shows how many books each class read.

everyday.def: something that people make or sell
everyday.ex: This store sells a new cleaning product.

school.def: the answer when you multiply numbers
school.ex: The product of 3 and 5 is 15.

everyday.def: a person who leads a country, like a king
everyday.ex: The ruler of the kingdom lived in a castle.

school.def: a straight tool used to measure length
school.ex: Use a ruler to measure the line in inches.

everyday.def: the body part at the end of your leg
everyday.ex: I hurt my foot playing soccer.

school.def: a unit of length equal to 12 inches
school.ex: The board is one foot long.

sort.s: Read the table to find which class read the most books.
Please put the plates on the table before dinner.
Multiply 4 and 7 to find the product.
My mom bought a new hair product at the store.
Measure the pencil with a ruler.
My foot hurts because my new shoes are too small.

questions.q: "The product of 6 and 4 is 24." What does product mean here?

options.text: something a store sells
the answer to a multiplication problem
the first number in a list

questions.why: The numbers 6, 4, and 24 show we are multiplying, so product is the answer.

questions.q: "Use the table to find how many apples Ana picked." What does table mean here?

options.text: rows and columns that show facts
furniture with a flat top
a list of rules for a game

questions.why: You use this table to find a number, so it shows facts in rows and columns.

questions.q: "The plant grew one foot this summer." What does foot mean here?

options.text: the body part at the end of your leg
the bottom of a hill
a length of 12 inches

questions.why: A plant grows taller, so foot is a unit that measures length here.

write.prompt: Write a sentence that uses product the math way.

3-5.title: More Math Words with Two Meanings
3-5.titleEs: Más palabras de matemáticas con dos significados

everyday.def: shaped like a circle or ball
everyday.ex: The ball is round.

school.def: to change a number to a close, easier number
school.ex: Round 48 to the nearest ten to get 50.

everyday.def: flat and smooth, with no bumps
everyday.ex: We need an even floor so the chair does not wobble.

school.def: a whole number you can split into two equal groups
school.ex: Six is an even number because 3 plus 3 is 6.

everyday.def: strange or not usual
everyday.ex: I heard an odd noise in the night.

school.def: a whole number you cannot split into two equal groups
school.ex: Seven is an odd number.

everyday.def: to make something different
everyday.ex: I want to change my shirt before the party.

school.def: the money you get back when you pay too much
school.ex: I paid 5 dollars for a 3 dollar book, so my change was 2 dollars.

sort.s: Round 73 to the nearest ten.
The pizza is round and cut into eight slices.
Every even number ends in 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8.
My cat made an odd sound, like a tiny squeak.
The clerk gave me 25 cents in change after I paid.
The leaves change color in the fall.

questions.q: "Nine is an odd number." What does odd mean here?

options.text: strange or unusual
very large
a number that cannot be split into two equal groups

questions.why: The sentence talks about the number nine, so odd means it cannot make two equal groups.

questions.q: "Round 62 to the nearest ten." What does round mean here?

options.text: to change a number to a close, easier number
shaped like a circle
to walk around in a circle

questions.why: The words nearest ten tell you to change 62 to 60.

questions.q: "The toy cost 4 dollars. I paid with 5 dollars and got 1 dollar in change." What does change mean here?

options.text: a new way of doing something
money you get back
coins you keep in a bank

questions.why: You paid more than the toy cost, so the store gave money back.

write.prompt: Write a sentence that uses even the math way.
write.model: Ten is an even number because you can make two equal groups of five.

3-5.title: Science Words with Two Meanings
3-5.titleEs: Palabras de ciencias con dos significados

everyday.def: a problem or worry
everyday.ex: What is the matter? You look sad.

school.def: anything that takes up space and has mass
school.ex: Water, air, and rocks are all kinds of matter.

everyday.def: a person who wears new clothes for photos
everyday.ex: The model walked across the stage in a red coat.

school.def: a small copy or drawing that shows how something works
school.ex: We built a model of the solar system.

everyday.def: the best anyone has ever done
everyday.ex: She set a school record in the race.

school.def: to write down what you see or measure
school.ex: Record the temperature every morning.

everyday.def: to ride a bike
everyday.ex: We cycle to the park on Saturdays.

school.def: a set of steps that happen again and again
school.ex: The water cycle moves water from the ocean to the sky and back.

sort.s: Ice, water, and steam are all matter.
What is the matter with your bike?
Our class made a model of a volcano to show how it erupts.
Record the height of your plant in your science notebook each day.
He broke the record for the most jumps in a row.
The life cycle of a frog starts with an egg.

questions.q: "A rock is matter because it takes up space." What does matter mean here?

options.text: anything that takes up space and has mass
a problem or worry
something that is very important

questions.why: The clue takes up space tells you this is the science meaning.

questions.q: "Record how tall the plant is every day." What does record mean here?

options.text: the best anyone has ever done
a round disk that plays music
to write down what you observe

questions.why: You write down how tall the plant is, so record means to write it down.

questions.q: "The model of the heart shows how blood moves." What does model mean here?

options.text: a person who poses for pictures
a small copy that shows how something works
the newest kind of car

questions.why: The model shows how blood moves, so it is a copy used to explain.

write.prompt: Write a sentence that uses cycle the science way.
write.model: In the water cycle, rain falls and then water goes back up into the sky.

3-5.title: Map Words with Two Meanings
3-5.titleEs: Palabras de mapas con dos significados

everyday.def: a small metal tool that opens a lock
everyday.ex: I need my key to open the front door.

school.def: a box that explains the symbols on a map
school.ex: The key shows that a star means a capital city.

everyday.def: a tool that tells how much you weigh
everyday.ex: The nurse asked me to stand on the scale.

school.def: a line on a map that shows real distance
school.ex: The scale shows that one inch stands for 10 miles.

everyday.def: a big letter like A, B, or C
everyday.ex: Start your name with a capital letter.

school.def: the city where a state or country's leaders work
school.ex: Annapolis is the capital of Maryland.

everyday.def: a line or edge around a picture or page
everyday.ex: I drew a green border around my poster.

school.def: the line between two states or countries
school.ex: The river is the border between the two states.

sort.s: Look at the map key to find the symbol for a school.
I lost the key to my bike lock.
Use the scale on the map to find how far away the park is.
My sister stepped on the scale to see her weight.
Washington, D.C. is the capital of the United States.
Mexico is on the southern border of the United States.

questions.q: "Richmond is the capital of Virginia." What does capital mean here?

options.text: a big letter at the start of a name
money used to start a business
the city where the leaders of a state work

questions.why: Richmond is a city, so capital means the city where leaders work.

questions.q: "Canada is across the border from New York." What does border mean here?

options.text: the line between two countries
a design around the edge of a page
a gate at the front of a house

questions.why: Canada is a country, so border means the line between countries.

questions.q: "The scale shows that 1 inch on the map is 5 miles." What does scale mean here?

options.text: a tool that tells your weight
a line that shows real distance on a map
a thin plate on the skin of a fish

questions.why: The words inch, map, and miles show that scale is about distance.

write.prompt: Write a sentence that uses key the map way.
write.model: The key shows that a small tree means a park.

6-8.title: Math Words with Two Meanings
6-8.titleEs: Palabras de matemáticas con dos significados

everyday.def: how loud or soft a sound is
everyday.ex: Please turn down the volume on the TV.

school.def: the amount of space inside a three-dimensional figure
school.ex: The volume of the box is 60 cubic centimeters.

everyday.def: unkind or not nice to other people
everyday.ex: It was mean to laugh at his mistake.

school.def: the average: add the values, then divide by how many there are
school.ex: The mean of 4, 6, and 8 is 6.

everyday.def: a large group of different kinds of things
everyday.ex: The shop has a wide range of colors.

school.def: the difference between the greatest and least values in a data set
school.ex: The range of 3, 7, and 12 is 9.

everyday.def: the look on a person's face that shows a feeling
everyday.ex: Her expression showed that she was surprised.

school.def: a math phrase with numbers, variables, and operations but no equal sign
school.ex: The expression 3x plus 5 has a variable and two terms.

sort.s: Find the volume of a cube with sides of 3 inches.
Turn up the volume so everyone can hear the song.
To find the mean, add all the heights and divide by the number of students.
It was mean of him to take her seat on purpose.
Subtract the least value from the greatest value to find the range.
Write an expression for 5 more than a number n.

questions.q: "The mean of 2, 4, and 9 is 5." What does mean refer to here?

options.text: unkind
to want to say something
the average of a set of numbers

questions.why: A list of numbers with one result shows that mean is the average.

questions.q: "Simplify the expression 2x plus 3x." What does expression mean here?

options.text: a math phrase with numbers, variables, and operations
the look on a person's face
a common saying

questions.why: The variable x and the word simplify show this is a math expression.

questions.q: "The ages in the club are 11, 12, 14, and 17, so the range is 6." What does range mean here?

options.text: a row of mountains
the difference between the greatest and least values
a wide choice of things to buy

questions.why: 17 minus 11 is 6, so range tells how spread out the data is.

write.prompt: Write a sentence that uses volume the math way.
write.model: The volume of the box is 24 cubic inches.

6-8.title: Physical Science Words with Two Meanings
6-8.titleEs: Palabras de ciencias físicas con dos significados

everyday.def: a large amount or crowd of something
everyday.ex: A mass of people waited outside the stadium.

school.def: the amount of matter in an object
school.ex: A bowling ball has more mass than a soccer ball.

everyday.def: happening now or the most recent
everyday.ex: We talk about current news every Friday.

school.def: the flow of electric charge through a circuit
school.ex: The current lights the bulb when the circuit is closed.

everyday.def: a person who leads an orchestra or band
everyday.ex: The conductor waved her arms to start the music.

school.def: a material that lets heat or electricity pass through easily
school.ex: Copper is a good conductor of electricity.

everyday.def: the feeling of being strong and active
everyday.ex: I have more energy after a good breakfast.

school.def: the ability to do work or cause change
school.ex: A moving car has energy of motion.

sort.s: The mass of the rock is 250 grams.
Electric current flows through the wire and lights the bulb.
Our current class president is Maya.
Metal is a good conductor, so the spoon in the hot soup got warm.
The conductor of the school band raised his stick to begin the song.
Sunlight gives plants the energy they need to make food.

questions.q: "Aluminum foil is a conductor of heat." What does conductor mean here?

options.text: a material that lets heat or electricity pass through
a person who leads a band
a person who drives a bus

questions.why: Aluminum foil is a material, and the sentence is about heat.

questions.q: "When the switch is closed, current moves through the circuit." What does current mean here?

options.text: happening right now
a newspaper story
the flow of electric charge

questions.why: The words switch and circuit show this is about electricity.

questions.q: "A brick has more mass than a sponge of the same size." What does mass mean here?

options.text: a big crowd of people
the amount of matter in an object
how tall an object is

questions.why: The sentence compares two objects of the same size, so mass means how much matter each has.

write.prompt: Write a sentence that uses energy the science way.
write.model: A stretched rubber band stores energy that can make it fly across the room.

6-8.title: Lab Science Words with Two Meanings
6-8.titleEs: Palabras del laboratorio de ciencias con dos significados

everyday.def: a phone you carry with you
everyday.ex: Text me on my cell after school.

school.def: the smallest living unit that makes up all living things
school.ex: Your skin is made of millions of cells.

everyday.def: a large musical instrument with keys and pipes
everyday.ex: She played the organ at the wedding.

school.def: a body part made of tissues that does a special job
school.ex: The heart is an organ that pumps blood.

everyday.def: an answer or fix for a problem
everyday.ex: We found a solution to the noise problem in the hallway.

school.def: a mixture where one substance dissolves evenly into another
school.ex: Salt water is a solution.

everyday.def: the bottom part that holds something up
everyday.ex: The lamp has a heavy base so it will not tip over.

school.def: a substance with a pH higher than 7, such as baking soda
school.ex: Baking soda is a base, so it can cancel out an acid.

sort.s: Plant cells have a cell wall that animal cells do not have.
My cell rang during dinner, so I turned it off.
Each lung is an organ that takes in oxygen.
Sugar dissolved in water makes a solution.
Lemon juice is an acid, and soap is a base.
The base of the statue is made of stone.

questions.q: "Stir the sugar until the solution looks clear." What does solution mean here?

options.text: an answer to a hard problem
a mixture where one thing dissolves into another
a tool for stirring

questions.why: Sugar dissolves when you stir it, so solution means a mixture.

questions.q: "A microscope helps us see each cell in an onion skin." What does cell mean here?

options.text: the smallest living unit of a living thing
a small room in a jail
a phone you carry

questions.why: You need a microscope to see it, so cell means a tiny living unit.

questions.q: "The stomach is an organ that helps break down food." What does organ mean here?

options.text: a large instrument with pipes
a group of people who work together
a body part that does a special job

questions.why: The stomach is a body part, so organ has its science meaning.

write.prompt: Write a sentence that uses solution the science way.
write.model: When salt dissolves in water, it makes a solution.

6-8.title: Government Words with Two Meanings
6-8.titleEs: Palabras del gobierno con dos significados

everyday.def: one full turn of something, like a wheel
everyday.ex: The bike wheel made one revolution.

school.def: when people fight to replace their government with a new one
school.ex: The American Revolution began in 1775.

everyday.def: a celebration with friends, food, and fun
everyday.ex: We had a party for my birthday.

school.def: a group of people who share ideas about government and try to win elections
school.ex: Each political party chose a candidate for president.

everyday.def: a paper that shows how much money you owe
everyday.ex: The waiter brought the bill after dinner.

school.def: a written idea for a new law
school.ex: Congress voted on the bill to build new roads.

everyday.def: a cupboard with doors for storing things
everyday.ex: The cups are in the kitchen cabinet.

school.def: the group of top advisers who help the president
school.ex: The president met with the cabinet to talk about the budget.

sort.s: The French Revolution changed how France was ruled.
Each party held a big meeting to choose its leader for the election.
Mom paid the electric bill on time.
The Senate passed the bill, and it went to the president to sign.
The secretary of state is a member of the president's cabinet.
I put the cereal back in the cabinet above the sink.

questions.q: "The bill must pass both houses of Congress before it becomes a law." What does bill mean here?

options.text: a written idea for a new law
a paper that shows money you owe
the beak of a bird

questions.why: The words Congress and law show that bill means an idea for a law.

questions.q: "The candidate's party agreed with her plan for schools." What does party mean here?

options.text: a celebration
a person who helps at a store
a group that shares ideas about government

questions.why: A candidate belongs to a political group, so party means a group with shared ideas.

questions.q: "During the revolution, colonists fought to be free from the king." What does revolution mean here?

options.text: one full turn of a wheel
a fight to replace a government
a fast dance

questions.why: Colonists fought to be free from a king, so this is about government.

write.prompt: Write a sentence that uses cabinet the government way.
write.model: The president asked the cabinet for advice about the economy.
